newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro-Parliament urges freeze on aid to Belarus.
newsitem.headline: Euro-Parliament urges freeze on aid to Belarus.

text.p: The European Parliament on Thursday urged the 15-nation European Union to stop financial aid to Belarus because of doubts over its commitment to democracy.

Hardline Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko has been criticised in the West for using a huge victory in a November 24 referendum to rewrite the constitution and secure sweeping powers for himself.
The EU assembly, said that only democracy-related aid under the so-called TACIS programme, which includes measures to support a free and independent media, should be maintained.

The Parliament confirmed an earlier statement that it would go no further with a planned cooperation and partnership accord with the former Soviet republic until it had received "clear signals from the Belarus authorities of their intention fully to respect basic democratic and human rights."
The Parliament said in a statement that the EU should use its weight to put pressure on international organisations to freeze their own aid in a bid to force democracy in Belarus.
